item.title: How the media market and the internet broke America
item.description: On his final broadcast, Cronkite closed by thanking the audience for their trust and support. “Old anchormen,” he said, “don’t fade away. They just keep coming back for more.” After a brief pause, he ended with the familiar line that had closed countless broadcasts before it: “And that’s the way it is.” In retrospect, Cronkite probably should have said, “And that’s the way it was.”
